verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Jules API for creating sessions with a user's own API key (at most 3 keys per user), plus GitHub label assignment. Nothing shows organization-level delegation, impersonation, or creating sessions on behalf of other users. The API is a developer building block, not the delegated-session capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization
